notes.title: Patch Notes v1
notes.content:
Thank you to anyone who submitted me bug reports or other little mishaps. Here is everything I have rectified:

- Fixed various name errors and item descriptions that were missing.
- The Bar in Act 2 should no longer crash your game.
- Fixed a few progression errors in the Lyle Scenario in Act 3.
-  Removed the ability to return to certain areas that would cause cutscenes to replay.
- The Elemental Orbs, when their questline is completed, will teach all party members, even those not yet recruited, their signature techniques (except Bruja. He cannot learn magic.)
- Fixed an infinite item exploit in Alenvale.
- Fixed an issue where you could leave Faetria during the cultist riot early.
- Nerfed the Archpriest's Gloves.
